purpose: Independent stress tests of requests and native read-plan projection. Frozen before inference, not exhaustive or representative production accuracy.
scoring: must_handoff permits no planned queries; a handoff is correct for an unrepresentable request.
required_read handoff is a missed optimization, scored separately from wrong or overbroad acquisition.
valid_or_handoff checks the full plan when accepted; whole-plan handoff is allowed and reported separately.
No expected labels/rationales enter model input; no source execution, writes, research network, or private records.
Native projection and selector acceptance are separate stages; retain all first attempts.
Duplicate identical queries are an unnecessary-fetch issue even if individual queries are valid.
Observed first failures may become development cases later, never continue calling them held-out.
